cli_result_text:
Submitted the 14 files needed for this analysis, most important first:

1. **`packages/react-scripts/config/webpack.config.js`** (CRA) — contains the primary finding: a production-profiling alias block that maps `scheduler/tracing` → `scheduler/tracing-profiling`, both of which are removed React internals.
2. **`packages/scheduler/package.json`** (React 18.2.0) — proves `tracing.js`/`tracing-profiling.js` no longer ship in the `scheduler` package (files list only has `index.js`, `unstable_mock.js`, `unstable_post_task.js`); these backed React 16/17's experimental interaction-tracking Profiler API, dropped in the concurrent-rendering rework for 18.
3. **`packages/react-dom/package.json`** (React 18.2.0) — confirms the paired `react-dom/profiling` entry is still valid (`exports['./profiling']` exists), isolating exactly which half of the CRA alias is dead vs. live.
4. **`packages/react-error-overlay/package.json`** (CRA) — shows react-error-overlay's own devDependencies still pin `react`/`react-dom` at `^17.0.2` despite the rest of CRA v5 targeting React 18, evidence of a stale package frozen against an older React major (though it doesn't break at runtime since the overlay renders via an isolated iframe, not React itself).
5–6. **`refreshOverlayInterop.js`**, **`webpackHotDevClient.js`** (CRA) — the call sites that actually wire react-error-overlay into the dev server, needed to assess load-bearing-ness.
7. **`packages/babel-preset-react-app/create.js`** (CRA) — shows the classic/automatic JSX runtime selection and the always-on `babel-plugin-transform-react-remove-prop-types`, relevant to the legacy-PropTypes-convention finding.
8. **`packages/react/src/React.js`** (React 18.2.0) — the export surface used to confirm `PropTypes`/`createClass` are absent and `__SECRET_INTERNALS_DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED` is still exported but unreferenced by CRA.
9. **`packages/react-dom/src/client/ReactDOM.js`** (React 18.2.0) — same purpose for react-dom's internals export.
10. **`packages/react-dom/test-utils.js`** (React 18.2.0) — confirmed still live/exported, ruling it out as a dead-code candidate.
11–14. **`react-scripts/package.json`**, **`cra-template/template/src/index.js`**, **`react-app-polyfill/package.json`**, **`react-dev-utils/package.json`** — version-pin and template context establishing CRA v5.0.1 targets React 18 (e.g. templates already use `react-dom/client`'s `createRoot`), which is what makes the stale `scheduler/tracing` alias and the React-17-pinned error-overlay package stand out as leftovers rather than intentional back-compat.
